full_prompt_en: A square ornate fantasy illustration shows two long-necked blue-white waterbirds sweeping through an elaborate circular design above vivid koi. A broad dark outer border curves from the upper left toward the lower edge, enclosing a blue-gray interior filled with gold botanical pattern. The upper bird occupies the center and right, its long white neck curved into an S and its orange pointed bill directed left. One great wing opens toward the upper right, each feather defined by narrow blue and slate lines. Below it, a second bird crosses the middle from left to right with wings stretched widely, its pale head and bill nearly reaching the right side. Layered feathers overlap, creating a fan of cool blue, ivory, and muted gray. At the lower center, a red-and-white koi turns upward, its rounded body bright against darker waterlike swirls. Another smaller orange fish appears near the lower left edge. Fine curling ribbons and plant stems loop between the fish and birds, while oversized pale gold leaves fill the upper background. The ring and small decorative motifs have an aged metallic texture, contrasting with the soft luminous plumage. Light appears diffuse and even, but cream highlights on feathers and gold filigree give depth to the layered surfaces; deeper blue shadows collect where wings overlap. Thin ink-like contours articulate each feather, scale, and curling stem without making the large color fields feel flat. The palette is mainly powder blue, ivory, smoky slate, and antique gold, with red-orange fish as a concentrated accent. The overall composition is densely interlaced yet circularly balanced, using flowing wings, curved necks, and aquatic spirals to create a graceful mythic rhythm.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形华丽奇幻插图呈现两只蓝白色长颈水鸟，在繁复圆形图样中掠过鲜艳锦鲤上方。宽阔深色外圈从左上方向下缘弯去，圈住填有金色植物纹样的蓝灰色内部。上方水鸟占据中央和右侧，长白颈弯成S形，橙色尖喙朝左。一只大翅膀向右上展开，每根羽毛都以细蓝色和石板色线条界定。在它下面，第二只鸟从左向右横过中部，双翅宽展，浅色头部和嘴几乎抵达右边。层叠羽毛互相遮掩，形成冷蓝、象牙色与暗灰色羽扇。下方中央，一条红白锦鲤向上转身，圆润身体从较深的水状旋纹中跳出。另一条较小的橙色鱼靠近左下边缘。细卷丝带与植物茎在鱼和鸟之间环绕，大型浅金色叶子填满上部背景。圆圈和小装饰纹带有陈旧金属肌理，与柔和发亮的羽毛形成对照。光似乎漫射而均匀，但羽毛和金色细纹上的奶油色高光为层叠表面增加深度；翅膀相叠之处聚起深蓝影。细墨线般轮廓刻画每片羽毛、鱼鳞和卷茎，同时不让大色面显得扁平。配色主要是粉蓝、象牙色、烟灰石板色和古金色，红橙鱼身是集中的重音。整体构图密集交织却维持圆形平衡，以流动翅膀、弯曲颈部和水状旋纹形成优雅的神话节奏。
style_prompt_en: The illustration layers intricate ink-like contour work over softly shaded washes of powder blue, ivory, smoky slate, and antique gold. Large curved shapes and broad fans of fine parallel lines create flowing motion inside a strong circular framework. Decorative botanical filigree occupies the quieter spaces, making negative areas patterned rather than empty. Subtle metallic grain and parchment-like wear enrich the pale ground; small vivid red-orange accents punctuate the otherwise cool restrained palette. Diffuse light gives raised forms cream highlights and deeper blue overlap shadows without a single dramatic spotlight. Fine line density changes from tight patterned passages to smoother open color fields, keeping the dense scene legible. The overall effect is delicate, elaborate, and dreamlike, with ornamental rhythm and controlled warm-cool contrast.
style_prompt_zh: 这幅插图在粉蓝、象牙色、烟灰石板色与古金色的柔和渲染层上叠加精细墨线般轮廓。大型弯曲形体和细密平行线组成的宽大扇形，在强烈圆形框架内制造流动感。装饰性植物卷纹占据较安静的空间，使负空间有纹样而非完全空白。微妙金属颗粒与羊皮纸般磨损丰富浅色底，小面积鲜明红橙点缀克制的冷色主调。漫射光让隆起形体带奶油色高光，相叠处留有更深蓝影，却没有单一戏剧性聚光点。细线密度在紧凑纹样区域与平顺开阔色场之间变化，使繁密场景仍然清楚。整体效果精致、繁复而如梦，装饰节奏和受控冷暖对比是主要特征。
theme_en: Two blue-white waterbirds and red koi inside an ornate circular design
theme_zh: 华丽圆形图样中的两只蓝白水鸟与红色锦鲤
name: Stephanie Law
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
